Wrike is the trusted work delivery platform where AI extends what people can accomplish. From essential task management to human and AI-led enterprise workflows, Wrike gives organizations the governed, context-rich foundation they need to deliver their most consequential work without losing control of how it gets done. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide trust Wrike to deliver without doubt.


MANAGE WORK & PUT AI TO WORK — FROM ANYWHERE
• Access your Wrike account across web, desktop, and mobile apps
• Review and respond to @ mentions, Inbox items, and requests on the go
• Quickly access projects and tasks anytime, anywhere
• Assign, schedule, and track work across your team
• Visualize work your way with Board, Table, and Interactive Gantt chart views
• Build and automate tailored workflows with custom fields and workflow customizations
• Receive or submit requests through customized forms
• Access your personal and shared Dashboards
• View and share custom Reports with teams, executives, and clients
• Get a view into work conducted by AI Agents
• Surface actionable intelligence instantly with AI Insights — no digging required


PLANS FOR EVERY TEAM
• Free — Essential task management, $0/user/month
• Team — Intelligent project management, $10/user/month
• Business — Customizable platform to manage your workflows, $25/user/month
• Pinnacle — Built for complex workflows, contact us for pricing
• Apex — Powering human and AI-led enterprise workflows, contact us for pricing

DOWNLOAD THE WRIKE APP TODAY
You can set up a new Wrike account at: https://www.wrike.com, or on your phone.

Questions? Bugs? Contact our support team: https://help.wrike.com/hc/requests/new

For more information visit:
Our Newsroom: https://www.wrike.com/newsroom/
Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/wrike
